name: sentiment
description:
The score of each phrase by the scored words it holds: their mean, min or max.

what: "mean", "min" or "max" of the scores of the words. A phrase with no scored word gets an empty value.

dictionary: a file of two columns, a word and its score; the first row is the header, the file is read like `read` does.

The step writes the scores to a new column <column>_sentiment.

Example: semkit read core.csv sentiment --dictionary dictionary.csv write out.csv

options.name: --dictionary
options.description: a file of two columns, a word and its score; the first row is the header, the file is read like `read` does.

options.name: --what
options.description: "mean", "min" or "max" of the scores of the words. A phrase with no scored word gets an empty value.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: DICTIONARY
arguments.description: a file of two columns, a word and its score; the first row is the header, the file is read like `read` does. The same as --dictionary DICTIONARY.
